genes.summary: Tumor-suppressor gene. Certain founder pathogenic variants are documented at elevated frequency in some reference groups.
Tumor-suppressor gene. Specific founder pathogenic variants are documented in some reference groups.
Beta-hexosaminidase A. Recessive. Specific pathogenic variants are documented at elevated carrier frequency in some reference groups.
Beta-globin. Recessive. Carrier frequency of specific variants varies substantially across reference groups.
Recessive. Variant spectrum and carrier frequency differ across reference groups.

conditions.rationale: Specific BRCA1/BRCA2 founder pathogenic variants occur at higher frequency among people with Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry. There is no single BRCA1 mutation responsible for breast cancer.
not_measured: Most BRCA1/BRCA2 pathogenic variants outside the small curated founder set are not on a consumer SNP array.
Large rearrangements and copy-number variants are not detectable here.
conditions.screening_note: A curated founder variant appearing here warrants confirmatory clinical genetic testing, not a diagnosis. Absence here does NOT rule out a pathogenic variant, because most are not measured. Clinicians may consider family history and guideline-based screening regardless of this result.

conditions.rationale: Certain HEXA pathogenic variants show elevated carrier frequency in some reference groups. Carrier status requires confirmatory testing and reflects reproductive-risk counseling, not personal disease.
not_measured: Enzyme-activity testing (the clinical standard for carrier screening) is not represented by SNP genotypes.
conditions.screening_note: Carrier screening is a clinical decision. Consider targeted HEXA testing or enzyme assay where reproductive-risk counseling is relevant.

conditions.rationale: HBB variant carrier frequency varies substantially across reference groups, partly reflecting historical malaria exposure. This is population context, not a personal diagnosis.
not_measured: Hemoglobin electrophoresis and full HBB sequencing are the clinical standards and are not represented here.
conditions.screening_note: A carrier-consistent genotype warrants confirmatory hemoglobin testing and, where relevant, partner screening and counseling.

conditions.rationale: CFTR carrier frequency and variant spectrum differ across reference groups. A consumer array covers only a subset of pathogenic variants.
not_measured: The common F508del variant and most of the >2000 CFTR variants are not reliably covered by a consumer SNP array.
conditions.screening_note: Carrier screening uses targeted CFTR panels. Absence of a call here does not rule out carrier status.

scores.missing_data_method: mean-imputation of model SNPs per model spec (synthetic)
scores.limitations: Synthetic polygenic score for demonstration. NOT a validated clinical model. Polygenic susceptibility is separate from high-impact Mendelian variant interpretation. No percentile or absolute risk is reported because no validated comparison distribution or calibrated model is available.
